_comment: App Router settings. INSTALL_APP.sh copies this to config.json (which is never committed). Everything here is also editable in the app under Settings. Paths are relative to this file.

server._comment: port 80 is the usual web port: no number needed in the address. allowNetwork false = only this computer can open the page; true = other devices on your network (or VPN) can too. Both need a restart. extraHosts = other names this computer is reached by that the app should answer to, e.g. a Tailscale name like mac-mini.tailnet-name.ts.net (applies at once).

security._comment: loginEnabled true = everyone signs in before they see the page (turn it on in Settings → Access, which also creates the first user). Passwords live in passwordFile (bcrypt hashes, owner-only). No file = you are asked to create a login. Forgot every password? Delete that file and reload. sessionHours needs a restart.

data._comment: Where links and directories are kept, and the pictures uploaded for links. A changed path is used after a restart.

page._comment: title = the name at the top left and on the browser tab. rootName = the heading over the links that are not in a directory. allowEditing false hides Add link / New directory and refuses every change to links and directories. showSearch false hides the search box.
page.title: App Router

health._comment: enabled false = nothing is checked and every light is grey. intervalSeconds = time between rounds (5-3600). timeoutSeconds = how long to wait for an answer (1-60). recoveredMinutes = how long a link stays yellow after it answers again (0-1440). failuresBeforeDown = failed checks in a row before a link turns red (1-10).

appearance._comment: theme is light, dark, system (follows each device) or the id of one of your customThemes (made in Settings → Appearance).
